spots.name: Mural by Fabián Bravo Guerrero (Kato)
spots.blurb: This mural is by Fabián Bravo Guerrero (Kato), painted in 2024. It shows figurative. Two costumed dancers, one dressed in a traditional flamenco costume and the other in a traditional Korean costume, form a heart shape with their arms as they dance. Mural to the twinning with the city of Malaga, Spain.
